title: Bridal Shower Word Search, Free Printable Party Puzzle
metaDescription: A free bridal shower word search with 20 wedding words, from bouquet and veil to champagne. Print on Letter or A4 and give guests a quiet game at the party.
h1: Bridal Shower Word Search (Free Printable Puzzle)
intro: Print a free bridal shower word search with 20 words from bouquet and veil to honeymoon. It is a relaxed game for guests to enjoy while the bride-to-be opens gifts.
itemsNote: Every word is wedding related and none is tied to a particular tradition, so the sheet suits many cultures and ceremonies.

sections.heading: How to run it at the shower
body: This game works at brunches, tea parties and backyard gatherings because it needs only paper and a pen.

1. Put a copy at each place setting before guests arrive.
2. Announce that the first to circle all twenty words wins a small prize.
3. Let the bride read the list of words aloud when the winner finishes.
4. Ask each guest to share a wish for the couple using one of the words.
If the party is formal, set the puzzle beside a place card so it feels part of the table rather than an interruption.

sections.heading: Ways to make it your own
body:
* **Couple's story.** Replace five words with places, songs or nicknames that matter to the couple.
* **Advice cards.** After the puzzle, pass out cards where guests write a short bit of marriage advice using a word from the grid.
* **Rapid round.** Set a three-minute timer and see who finds the most words, instead of all of them.

sections.heading: Tips for hosts and maids of honor
body: Keep the prizes small and fun, such as a candle or a mini bottle of lotion. Large stakes make a quiet game feel competitive.
Make sure guests who prefer not to play have something else to do, like decorating a card for the couple.
Tell guests ahead that a puzzle will be part of the afternoon, so people who enjoy word games come ready to play.

sections.heading: Printing for an elegant table
body: Cream or blush cardstock gives the page a stationery feel. If you want it to match your invitations, print on the same paper stock.
Reduce the size of the word list or turn it off for a harder puzzle, then offer the list to only those who ask.

faq.q: Can I put the bride's name in the puzzle?
faq.a: Yes. Add her name and the groom's name to the list, then press Generate. Both are hidden in the grid along with the wedding words.

faq.q: How many puzzles should I print?
faq.a: One for each guest plus a few spares is enough. The multiple-puzzle setting gives each table different layouts.

faq.q: Is the puzzle suitable for a mixed-age crowd?
faq.a: Yes. The words are all familiar, so guests from teens to grandparents can join in.
